permissions.purpose: Lets Privatus Analytics read your subscriptions (status, dates, amount and plan) to show MRR, churn, retention and cohorts next to your website traffic. It cannot create or change anything.
Lets Privatus Analytics read product names so each plan shows its real name in the MRR by plan table.
Lets Privatus Analytics read recurring discounts on subscriptions so MRR is counted after discounts.
